description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to recognize the Sri Lanka International Buddhist Academy as a Degree Awarding Institute
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory instrument - an Order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It involves the statutory recognition of an educational institution as a degree-awarding institute, which constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
